Name: Jabal
Summary: Jabal was the son of Lamech and Adah, and the father of those who dwell in tents and keep cattle.
KeyStory: Jabal pioneered the nomadic life of herdsmen, a whole way of living that began with him.
RelatedPeople: Lamech, Son of Methusael; Adah, Wife of Lamech; Jubal
LifeLesson: Ordinary work — raising herds, pitching tents — is part of God's good design for human life.
